rationale: Turns portfolio navigation into embodied vehicle control inside one persistent 3D world, with desktop/mobile/gamepad mappings and explicit recoverability controls.
notes: Direct inspection confirms keyboard, touch, mouse, and gamepad controls; map, respawn/reset, achievements, and interactive world elements. The site explicitly documents Three.js, Rapier, Howler.js, source code and Blender files.

decision.rationale: Strong HCI anchor for replacing page-to-page navigation with embodied spatial control while still providing explicit recovery, mapping, and alternative HTML access.
